verdict.rationale: Mercury supports AP-adjacent automation — AI reads bills and auto-populates details for approval (mercury-docs-3), receipt auto-attachment (mercury-docs-5/28), payment routing with approval policies (mercury-docs-47, mercury-docs-55), and QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite sync with AI-powered close automations (mercury-docs-6) — but there is no evidence of purchase-order creation/management, three-way PO-to-invoice matching, or GL coding logic tied to POs anywhere in the pack. missing for 10: purchase order data model/API, automated PO-invoice matching logic, GL/expense coding rules engine, end-to-end evidence of the full match-code-route workflow rather than separate bill-pay and sync features.
